title: selfcheck's host line over both load limits is cut inside its remedy, so the host-load remedy never shows
goal: bl_selfcheck.check_host at a load over both LOAD_PER_CORE and SUITE_LOAD_PER_CORE renders through line_of within LINE_MAX with both remedies readable, so the line does not end in [cut]

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_selfcheck as s;r=s.check_host(load=30.0,cores=14);t=s.line_of(r);sys.exit(1 if t.endswith('[cut]') else 0)
